title: God's Numbers — Addition and Subtraction Quiz
description: Test your addition and subtraction skills!

questions.question: What is 3 + 4?
questions.explanation: 3 + 4 = 7. When we put 3 and 4 together, we get 7.

questions.question: What is 9 - 3?
questions.explanation: 9 - 3 = 6. When we take 3 away from 9, we have 6 left.

questions.question: Noah brought animals in pairs (groups of 2). How many animals are in 4 pairs?
What does the plus sign (+) mean?
questions.explanation: The plus sign (+) means to put groups together, or add.

questions.question: Jesus had 12 disciples. If 5 went fishing, how many stayed with Jesus?
David found 6 stones and then found 4 more. How many stones did he have in all?
